description: Moneybird invoice of the subscription invoice

moneybird_invoice_number.description: Moneybird invoice number (sales invoices) or reference (external sales invoices)

moneybird_invoice_url.description: Link to the invoice in Moneybird

moneybird_state.description: Invoice state in Moneybird when the app last changed it, e.g. draft, open, paid

moneybird_paid_at.description: When the payment was registered in Moneybird

moneybird_refunds.description: Moneybird credit invoice IDs by Swell refund ID, saved as soon as each is created

moneybird_refunds_done.description: Swell refund IDs whose credit invoice is finished (numbered and paid), so each refund is sent once

moneybird_credit_invoices.description: Credit invoices made for refunds, one per line

moneybird_note.description: Tax rate or total differences found when the invoice was created

moneybird_status.description: Invoice state shown in the admin, e.g. Open, Paid
